project.name: Importer — Postman
project.description:
Turns a Postman Collection (v2.0 or v2.1) into draft scenarios grouped by folder.
A collection is the source closest to a test that already exists: somebody curated these requests, gave them names, put them in folders and made them work. That is exactly what an importer wants and cannot otherwise get.
It is also a source that carries executable code. Collections hold pre-request and test scripts, and CLAUDE.md §23 is explicit that they are flagged and never evaluated: the control plane does not run code that arrived in a document. They are reported, with the requests they belong to, and left for a person.
Collections also carry credentials — an auth block, a variable named token holding a working value, a saved sign-in body with a real password. All are refused and reported, on the same rules the cURL, OpenAPI and HAR importers use.
Depends on platform-domain, plus Jackson for reading the collection — the same reasoning as importer-openapi and importer-har. No Spring, persistence, engine or Kubernetes types; ModuleDependencyRulesTest enforces that.
